# DEX223

> DEX223 is a decentralized exchange (DEX) for ERC-223 and ERC-20 tokens. It was the first exchange to support the ERC-223 token standard. Every pool accepts both standards, a built-in converter moves tokens between ERC-20 and ERC-223 at 1:1 (EIP-7417), and anyone can list a token without permission through on-chain auto-listing contracts. DEX223's contracts are deployed on Ethereum mainnet, where the first liquidity pools have not been created yet. Swaps and margin trading are live on the Sepolia testnet.

DEX223 is non-custodial: people trade from their own wallets and sign every transaction themselves. The project is run by DEX223 DAO LLC. Its utility and governance token is D223.

## Key facts

- Supported token standards: ERC-223 and ERC-20, in the same pools.
- Converter: ERC-20 and ERC-223 versions of a token convert 1:1 through EIP-7417. Converting has no protocol fee.
- Approvals: ERC-223 swaps need no approval transaction. ERC-20 swaps still need one.
- Gas: in a measured example, an ERC-20 swap used 257K gas (45K approval plus 212K swap) and the same ERC-223 swap used 220K gas with no approval.
- Listing: permissionless. A token is listed by paying an anti-spam fee to an auto-listing contract, or by importing a token list. No application to the team is needed.
- Margin trading: "Encapsulated Margin Trading". Lenders set their own terms, and borrowers can trade the borrowed tokens but cannot withdraw them. Live on Sepolia testnet; Ethereum mainnet is planned after a security audit.
- ERC-20 losses: about $201,690,000 worth of ERC-20 tokens had been lost to the standard's design flaw on Ethereum mainnet as of 29 August 2023. ERC-223 is designed to prevent these losses.
- Chains: contracts deployed on Ethereum mainnet (no liquidity pools yet; trading is live on Sepolia testnet). Confirmed for future deployment: Avalanche, BSC, EOS EVM, CELO, Base, Optimism and Arbitrum.

## D223 token

- Ticker: D223. Standard: ERC-223, convertible to ERC-20 via EIP-7417. Decimals: 18. Max supply: 8,000,000,000 D223.
- Ethereum contract: 0x0908078da2935a14bc7a17770292818c85b580dd
- Holders who lock D223 take part in governance and share in listing, trading and liquidity fees.

## Common questions

- What is DEX223? A decentralized exchange where you can swap, provide liquidity, lend, borrow and trade on margin with ERC-20 and ERC-223 tokens.
- Do I need ERC-223 tokens to use it? No. Every pool accepts both standards, and the converter moves tokens between them at 1:1.
- How do I list a token? Open Token listing in the app, pick an auto-listing contract and confirm. No approval from the team is needed.
- Is DEX223 custodial? No. You trade from your own wallet, and DEX223 never holds your keys.
- What does trading cost? The pool's fee tier, which goes to its liquidity providers, plus network gas.
- What is the difference between ERC-20 and ERC-223? ERC-223 lets a receiving contract handle or reject incoming tokens, so tokens sent to the wrong contract are not lost, and it needs no separate approval transaction. ERC-20 cannot do either.
